constraints: Os perfis são configuração e roteamento; não representam 13 modelos generativos conectados.
Nenhum agente executa ações externas, destrutivas ou financeiras por conta própria.
Memória compartilhada recebe propostas; gravação durável depende de política e aprovação.
HD-MATRIZ permanece fora do escopo desta implementação.

appliesTo: all HTML/HTM pages whether linked in navigation or not
coreRules: Never trust client-side HTML, JavaScript, game state, score, inventory, identity, price, or permission claims.
Never execute arbitrary commands on a production host; terminal work must use an isolated sandbox, least privilege, time limits, outbound allowlists, and audit logs.
Never bypass authentication, authorization, TOTP, approval, rate limits, or security controls.
Never copy, export, expose, or replicate private HD-MATRIZ data, credentials, sessions, tokens, or backups into public repositories or pages.
Never patch, inject into, or execute untrusted binaries; verify provenance, cryptographic signatures, and SHA-256/SHA-512 hashes before deployment.
Treat heuristic detections as alerts for human review; do not delete, quarantine, or modify files automatically.
Scan every discovered page and asset recursively, including files not linked in menus; report excluded directories and oversized files explicitly.
Keep security decisions, detections, and administrative actions auditable; preserve evidence without storing secrets.

protectedControls.server: least-privilege service account, no root runtime, isolated processes, secrets only in host secret manager, patching, backups, audit logs
protectedControls.hdMatriz: private-by-default, TOTP gate according to the approved HD-MATRIZ protocol, short administrative sessions, no secrets in Git or backups, restore only after integrity verification and approval
protectedControls.terminals: dedicated terminal permission, explicit authorization, sandbox-only execution, command/output hashes, timeout, egress allowlist, no production host shell
protectedControls.uploads: validate MIME and file signatures, size limits, malware scan before publication, store outside executable web roots, random object IDs, no inline rendering of untrusted HTML/SVG
protectedControls.pages: security headers and CSP at server/CDN, no secrets in client assets, server-side authorization for protected routes, cover hidden/unlinked pages as well as menu pages
protectedControls.game: server-authoritative state, server-side score/economy validation, replay/idempotency checks, rate limits, anomaly logging; never rely on client anti-cheat alone
protectedControls.binaries: signed releases, dependency pinning and provenance, hash verification, immutable deployment artifacts, alert on unexpected binary changes
protectedControls.antiCopy: do not promise prevention of browser copying; protect sensitive content through authorization, minimal disclosure, download/export controls, and audit

hardStops: agent asks to bypass a security control
attempt to read or replicate private data without authorization
production host command execution outside approved sandbox
integrity mismatch in HD-MATRIZ or backup
humanApprovalRequired: change authentication, TOTP, admin roles, or secrets
deploy a server agent or change production infrastructure
block an account, process, IP, or service in production
scopeLimitations: This profile is an instruction/configuration overlay, not model fine-tuning or proof that 13 independent AI models are connected.
Browser-delivered HTML/JavaScript cannot be made impossible to copy or modify on a user's device.
Repository scans do not protect a live host, runtime memory, network traffic, or external hosting until host-level integration is deployed and verified.
